benefits: Reduces daily hair fall and breakage as a supportive therapy.

High safety margin with predictable thermal delivery and epidermal sparing.

Elevates patient satisfaction with visible clarity and smoothing outcomes.

data.description: EPTQ dermal fillers (S100, S300, S500) combine 24 mg/ml cross-linked medical-grade HA with 0.3% lidocaine for comfortable injection.
